formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low (C6): no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3), with the mild anionic Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate (4).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Isethionate is an effective mild anionic; Coco-Glucoside (19) and Sodium Isethionate (18) are post-fragrance.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (bounded): one cationic system Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (17) plus several light routes: Glycol Distearate (16), Glyceryl Oleate (11), Glyceryl Stearate (21), Coconut Acid (15) and humectants Glycerin (10), Sodium PCA (20). C2 not met (no early silicone or prominent payload lipid).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: All care routes are post-fragrance; low is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one post-fragrance guar and weak refatters; no silicone, oil, butter, protein or film former. Reset is weak (mild C6), but the deposition it faces is light.

depositionLoad.rationale: Guar (17), Glyceryl Oleate (11), Coconut Acid (15), Glyceryl Stearate (21).

persistence.rationale: No persistent silicone, lipid or film system.

context_humectants.ingredient: Amino acids (Arginine 6, Serine 7, Glycine 13, Histidine 14, Aspartic Acid 22 ...)

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only light routes, all post-fragrance: low anchor despite weak reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families present, but they are one post-fragrance guar and weak_refatter esters (glyceryl oleate/stearate, coconut acid) plus humectants and amino acids; no silicone, oil, butter or film converges, so even weak reset leaves no noticeable residue.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Weak reset does not offset the guar (neighbor moderate).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: moisture_supported (humectant cluster Glycerin 10, Sodium PCA 20, PCA 12, amino acids, aloe juice 2, with guar and refatter conditioning support); repair not distinguished.
